sourceTimeScale: Universal Time (UT1 per the linked USNO time definition); not TT
precision: minute; no rounding rule or subminute instant inferred
selection: Every New Moon and Full Moon row in each annual response; quarter phases retained in raw responses but excluded from comparison
derivation: New Moon means directed Moon-minus-Sun apparent ecliptic longitude 0 degrees; Full Moon means 180 degrees. Calendar fields and HH:mm are formatted as an unshifted ISO minute label with zero seconds; Z is a comparison label, not a UT1-to-UTC conversion.

comparison.purpose: coarse published-time agreement, not a physical error bound
comparison.rationale: Minute-resolution source, UT1 labels compared without conversion to modern engine UTC inputs, and differing ephemeris reductions. No separate error contributions estimated; no threshold fitted to engine output.
